card.name: Middle initial H in author names
card.fires_on: The letter H (or the period after it) used as a middle or first initial in a person's name, mostly in author bylines and citations, as in Robert H. Shmerling.

modes.label: Initial H in a name
modes.description: The letter H or the following period right after a first name or another initial in a byline or reference.

modes.label: Other initials in citations
modes.description: Initials or a following word start in reference lists or name-like spots.

card.writes: No clear output effect; it may slightly favor words that follow or come after.
card.plain: It lights up on the letter H in a person's initials, such as Robert H. Shmerling, in bylines and references.
